answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 28748 Country: India Title: A woman is mensturating initially for two days and then on eighth day or ninth day. When can her husband derive the sexual pleasure from her. Question: Respected ifta council, Assalamualaikum. A woman is mensturating initially for two days and then on eighth day or ninth day. When can her husband derive the sexual pleasure from her. Answer ID: 28748 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 95/75/L=1432) In the question mentioned above, total nine days shall be counted of menstruation, during which her husband cannot have intercourse with her. Once nine days are over and blood discharge stops and wife performs ghusl or time of one salah passes over her, then her husband can have intercourse with her even if she did not perform ghusl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
